_README: Generated by scripts/rebuild_atlas.py from Data/_rebuild/truth_*.csv and the shipped trees. EVERY value here is computed at run time; none is hard-coded. This file is the single source for the manuscript's and the figures' headline quantities -- read it, do not retype the numbers. Numerator and denominator are column sums of Data/coverage_basis.csv, so a denominator that exists in no file cannot be written down.

rule_parameters.note: RULES, not reported quantities. No coverage figure anywhere in this file is a literal.

scope.denominator_universe: described species over the 60 eukaryotic partitions
scope.all_life: SI only, and Figure 1, always labelled as such

all_life.note: SI and Figure 1 ONLY, and it must be labelled all-life there. NEVER a coverage denominator.

C0.definition: NAMED: the tip label occurs in a retained eukaryotic canonical tree

C1.definition: MOLECULAR: C0 and the tip is in the molecular analysis behind that tree

C1d.definition: DATED: C1 and the shipped canonical tree is a measured chronogram

C1u.definition: UNCERTAINTY AVAILABLE: C1d and the source archive carries a node-age distribution or interval a user can propagate (a sampled tree set whose node ages vary among the sequenced species, or annotated intervals), whatever its relation to the calibration prior (D55); the last level (D58)

rung_definitions.C1: MOLECULAR: C0 and the tip is in the molecular analysis behind that tree
rung_definitions.C1d: DATED: C1 and the shipped canonical tree is a measured chronogram
rung_definitions.C1u: UNCERTAINTY AVAILABLE: C1d and the source archive carries a node-age distribution or interval a user can propagate (a sampled tree set whose node ages vary among the sequenced species, or annotated intervals), whatever its relation to the calibration prior (D55); the last level (D58)

naming_discipline: C1 is MOLECULARLY SUPPORTED PLACEMENT, operationalised by tip evidence within the analysis that produced the tree. It is NOT a predicate on placement traceability: f_mol is an axis-(a) quantity. The genuine axis-(b) distinction is reported as the NOMINAL annotation topology_assembly and never as a rung, because the deposit carries no measured per-tip placement-warrant flag. Methods must say so plainly; claiming the two-axis conflict was 'dissolved' is an overclaim a referee will catch.
monotonicity: the rungs are nested weighted sums with weights in [0,1], hence non-increasing; verified per partition, 60 partitions, zero violations. NESTED TIP SETS ARE NOT CLAIMED: the computed object is an expectation, and the advertised proof describes the computed object.
units: C0 counts SPECIES. C1 and below count TIP-EQUIVALENTS wherever the partition is not enumerated in Data/molecular_tips.csv. Do not write 'species' at C1 or below for a partition that is not listed there.

prokaryotic_line.note: reported on its own line. Prokaryotes NEVER enter a eukaryotic numerator or denominator.

trees.rule: root-to-tip coefficient of variation measured on the SHIPPED .nwk file with the audit's recursive parser (truth_dated.csv), AND branch lengths in absolute time (Data/time_scale_checks.csv; D14: an ultrametric tree in relative time is its own class); the ledger's `dated` column is never read
trees.note: everything at C1d and below rests on these trees ONLY
trees.withheld_rule: a tree file is withheld from the data release when its source states no licence (Data/tree_licences.csv, redistribution class no-licence-stated); n_shipped counts the trees the paper used, n_redistributed those the release carries, n_withheld those it lists in registers/withheld_trees.csv

topology_assembly.classifier: automated_synthesis if otl_pipeline_involvement == 'full_pipeline'; compiled if inference in ['synthesis', 'literature_compilation', 'supertree_re_dated']; else primary_analysis
topology_assembly.source: derived from UNRECONCILED fields of Data/tree_provenance.csv (the pre-audit ledger). Methods MUST state this. It is an ANNOTATION, not a criterion: nominal, unordered, no strong/weak reading.

Birds.note: the band moves C1, C1d and (if date uncertainty is available) C1u

represented_partitions_only.note: the denominator restricted to partitions that have a canonical tree at all; the structural zeros are removed from BOTH sides

largest_single_count.note: one round number from a single compilation carries this share of the whole eukaryotic denominator; every printed decimal in the paper is elastic to it

elasticity_demonstration.warning: AN ELASTICITY DEMONSTRATION, NOT A RICHNESS CLAIM. The perturbation is a device for showing how much of every printed decimal rests on one round number.

c1_definition.definition_primary: C1 = distinct CoL accepted names (GTDB clusters for prokaryotes) among the tips in the molecular analysis (basis column c1_units)
c1_definition.definition_product: C1 = c0_units * f_mol, a label fraction applied to name units

c0_gbif_unmatched.rule: C0 plus, per partition, the GBIF backbone accepted species (strict match, EXACT or FUZZY, rank SPECIES) of the tips COL26.9 leaves unmatched, not already counted under the same 'Genus epithet'

c1u_sequence_dating.rule: C1u where the archive holds dated trees of a posterior or bootstrap dating of sequence data (crown_intervals kind in ('posterior_sample', 'bootstrap_dating_sample')) whose crown is neither degenerate nor on a bound (D61)

dominance.note: state this and frame the asymmetry as the finding, not as a caveat

overlapping_labels.note: outgroups and homonyms. C0 is quoted on the UNION convention; the per-partition SUM is given alongside so the two can never drift. EVERY derived quantity -- dark matter above all -- must use the union figure consistently.

structural_zeros.note: a STRUCTURAL zero, not a criterion-dependent one -- and now computable from the deposit file itself, because these partitions are rows of coverage_basis.csv.

dark_matter.convention: formed on the C0 UNION numerator (395517), never on the per-partition sum
dark_matter.replaces: the retired 23.7 % figure, which was a hard-coded literal reachable from no numerator/denominator pair in the deposit. WITHDRAWN, not adjusted.

notes: imputation_status='none': the shipped tree IS the molecular analysis, so it is its own source and scores 1 by the same formula, not by exception.

tip_convention: distinct standardised labels in the shipped Newick file (truth_tips.csv `tips_adopted`)
retired: THE 23.7 % COVERAGE HEADLINE. A hard-coded literal at Paper/code/figures/fig2_sensitivity_bounds.py:61, reachable from no numerator/denominator pair in the deposit; its implied denominator, 2,084,409, exists in no file. WITHDRAWN, NOT ADJUSTED. This script owns no file under Paper/code/, so the deletion of that file and its literal is REPORTED here, not performed.

THE OLD MIDDLE RUNG 'C1 = 8.65 %'. It never had a principled definition: the published table applied a molecular fraction to three partitions at one criterion and to every partially-imputed canonical at the next, a scope not derivable from any deposited field.

THE OLD STRICT CRITERION, which dropped whole partitions categorically while scaling others proportionally -- two different operations under one label. It could not tell 85 % molecular support from 5 %: both scored zero. The reader who wants that view now reads it off ONE sensitivity line (sensitivities.leave_assembly_class_out.retain_only_primary_analysis).

THE min(x, 100) COVERAGE CAP and the hard-coded collection-backed slug list in prep_data.py. No eukaryotic canonical partition exceeds 100 %, proved by the invariant check on every run, so a cap could only ever mask a defect. This script owns neither file; the deletions are reported.

THE LEDGER'S `dated` COLUMN as a source of truth. Time calibration is now measured from tree geometry and shipped with its root-to-tip CV, so a reader may set their own tolerance instead of inheriting a bit.
open_flags: PER-TIP ENUMERATION IS PARTIAL. molecular_tips.csv enumerates C1 only for the partitions whose molecular source is a deposited tree. Everywhere else C1 is an expectation, so the paper must write TIP-EQUIVALENTS, never species, at C1 and below. Completing the enumeration is the single highest-value remaining data task.

LABEL-MATCHING RULE FOR f_mol -- A DELIBERATE CHOICE, FLAGGED FOR REVIEW. The intersection behind f_mol resolves BOTH sides through the deposit's own name mapping (dictionary.csv for the shipped tree's numeric ids; full_mapping.csv for the raw source's original labels). Naive exact-label matching was rejected because it is a measurement artefact: it scores a source whose labels carry collector or voucher decorations at or near ZERO, which is a fact about label formatting, not about molecular support. The adopted rule changes exactly one partition's number relative to naive matching, and it moves that number CLOSER to the numerator the ground truth independently recorded. Both figures are published per partition in headline_numbers.json -> molecular_evidence (measured_intersection vs exact_label_intersection), so either can be reproduced. If the exact-label rule is preferred instead, that is a one-line change here and it must be made consistently for every partition, not only where it is convenient.

TOPOLOGY_ASSEMBLY RESTS ON UNRECONCILED LEDGER FIELDS. It is derived from `inference` and `otl_pipeline_involvement` in Data/tree_provenance.csv -- the same ledger whose `dated` column is wrong wherever it can be checked. That is exactly why it is a NOMINAL ANNOTATION and never a rung, and Methods must say so. If those two fields are ever reconciled and certified, the annotation can be promoted; until then it cannot.

TWO TREE COLLECTIONS. Data/site/data/partitions/<slug>/tree.nwk is a second, curated collection that disagrees with Data/standardized/trees/ on several partitions. The truth files and therefore this script follow the standardized collection, per the settled 'the shipped file governs' rule. If the curated collection is the deposit of record instead, every number here must be rebuilt.

FIGURE-1 WORKAROUND NOW REDUNDANT. The deposited fig1_coverage_bars.csv carried several canonical eukaryote partitions with is_unrepresented=True and blank tip counts, and Paper/code/figures/fig1_dotplot.py compensates by overriding them from a separate overlay CSV. The rebuilt file fixes the root cause, so that reconciliation block should be DELETED rather than left to fight a file that is now correct.

offtarget_D7.rule: D7: tips outside the partition are pruned from the canonical tree before counting and before crown-node extraction

deposited_chronogram_D8.rule: D8: where the same study deposited a chronogram covering at least the shipped tips, it becomes the canonical file; otherwise the gap is reported

name_resolution_S05.authority: Catalogue of Life COL26.9 base release (ChecklistBank 316321, doi:10.48580/dgz5n), through Data/standardized/col_resolution.csv
name_resolution_S05.rule: a tip counts at C0 when it resolves to a CoL accepted name; tips resolving to the same accepted name count once

crown_ages.definition: crown age of the focal clade (Data/crown_clades.csv, D21) by decision D20: the deposit's annotated median height, or the median height over its dated tree set, else the focal node's height in the deposited chronogram, else the canonical root height; the interval is the one the deposit carries (Data/crown_intervals.csv, scripts/crown_intervals.py). A deposit counts for C1u when it carries a node-age distribution or interval a user can propagate (D55). The crown interval is described against the calibrations (not_excluded_by_rule, D58; no coverage level): not excluded when its kind counts and it is neither degenerate nor at a calibration bound (D22) nor within the range calibrations allow the crown without being halved (rule p, D25, D52) nor from a set whose root ages are drawn from the calibration prior (rule r, D29, D51).

coverage_union.rule: union convention: each accepted species once, assigned to the group in which it reaches the furthest level (ties: first group in name order); losses are set differences of consecutive levels, by the reason of the assigned group

union_bound_S09.definition: C0 over the union of all distributed eukaryotic trees: accepted names of the canonical tips plus those of every other shipped tree's tips not already counted; each added tip assigned to a partition by its CoL family (map measured on the canonical tips), else by its tree's partition. C1 over the union is a band: added names at weight 0 and at weight 1.

opentree_P01.definition:
Open Tree's counterpart of C1 is its 'tips from phylogeny': leaves of the
    grafted solution, i.e. taxa placed by at least one input phylogeny.  Only
    those that are extant species-rank taxa are compared (Data/external/,
    written by scripts/opentree_extract.py).  Open Tree counts a SET of
    leaves, including ones placed by morphological input trees; atlas C1 is an
    f_mol-weighted count.  Names are compared on the S05 query of each atlas
    tip (its species key, decision D4, or its documented override) against
    the Open Tree name's Genus_epithet, by exact spelling and without
    synonymy, so 'keys_both' is a lower bound.
opentree_P01.release: opentree16.1 (synthesis 2025-12-20, OTT 3.7.3); API tree_of_life/about synth_id opentree16.1

molecular_enumerated.accepted_rule: R1-14: molecular tips and Open Tree phylogeny-placed species both resolved to COL26.9 accepted names by the S05 rule (scripts/match_col.py), compared by accepted-name id, so synonymy no longer separates the two sets

worked_example_S13.definition: constant-rate birth-death with uniform sampling fraction rho (Stadler 2009) on each eligible canonical chronogram rescaled to its reported crown age (D20): the full tree and the tree pruned to its molecular tips at rho = tips/described, and the pruned tree at rho = full-tree tips/described (the full-tree fraction misapplied to the molecular tree); 95% profile-likelihood intervals, conditional on the single tree fitted (no topological or dating uncertainty)
worked_example_S13.eligibility: eukaryotic canonical chronogram in absolute time whose molecular tips are enumerated and fewer than all tips; every eligible partition is reported, none is selected

test_family.rule: a test is reported only where its model assumptions hold for the tree: one likelihood-ratio test per eligible group whose pruned summary tree is binary and whose node ages are estimated by a dating analysis; on a summary tree with polytomies (a consensus tree) or with assigned and interpolated node ages the statistic is reported without a test; the family is fixed by the trees before any statistic is read; Bonferroni level = 0.05 / n_tests (D50, D59, D60)

worked_example_S13.identity: the likelihood depends on lambda and rho only through lambda*rho and r (Stadler 2009), so a fit at rho' is the fit at rho with lambda scaled by rho/rho' and r and the log-likelihood unchanged, unless that forces mu < 0; then mu = 0 and the likelihood drops (the rho-epsilon confounding: Cusimano & Renner 2010 Syst Biol 59:458; Hoehna et al. 2011 Mol Biol Evol 28:2577). Each pair is classified 'identity' or 'boundary'; at the boundary lr_statistic = 2 (logL(rho_tips) - logL(rho_full)) and rho_full is rejected when it exceeds the critical value of the 50:50 chi2(0):chi2(1) mixture at the Bonferroni level 0.05 / (number of eligible groups) (test_family, F4-01, D50): in the parameters of the matching fit, the fit at rho_full is the same model restricted to epsilon >= 1 - rho_tips/rho_full, an edge inside (0, 1), so the null distribution at that edge is the mixture (Chernoff 1954; Self & Liang 1987; D27, D30). Every interval uses the cutoff qchisq(0.95, 1)/2; where the epsilon estimate is 0 the interval is [0, upper] (D30)

family_sampling_fit.definition: the molecular tree with each tip's sampling fraction = accepted names among the family's molecular tips / the family's accepted species in COL26.9 (capped at 1; tips with no resolved family take rho = tips/described), clade-specific likelihood of FitzJohn, Maddison & Otto 2009; the rho = tips/described fits are conditional on uniform sampling, which the per-family fractions contradict. The family and uniform likelihoods carry different probabilities of sampling the same tips, terms free of the rates, so they are not compared; the estimates are reported side by side (D30)

full_vs_molecular.note: two different trees, not a rung effect: the difference is what taxonomically placed tips do to the estimate (Rabosky 2015 Evolution 69:3207; Chang, Rabosky & Alfaro 2020 Syst Biol 69:602)
